# Public request fixtures

`cc-transcripts-2.1.317.json` contains only this project's fictional messages and the transcript blocks generated by an unmodified, installed Claude Code 2.1.317 through a loopback fake API. No user sessions, real credentials, proprietary system policies or stage suffixes are included. These fixtures cover explicit permission, its subsequent revocation, assistant prose, prior reviewed Bash calls, filtered tool results, quoted transcript/forwarded tags, fullwidth delimiters and zero-width text. Both stages are captured independently. Regenerate with `capture_claude()`; the public subset is written inside `official-cc-probe/`.

`codex-line-review.txt` is a fictional shell-review example using the line transcript and action framing in the Apache-2.0 OpenAI Codex source at commit `ce21072c90d32c40af7a55b60b2fb35c84a43a6a`, particularly `codex-rs/guardian-context/src/{composition,action,transcript}.rs` and its public Guardian layout snapshot. It is a source-layout golden, not a captured end-to-end CLI run. OpenAI's license and notice are in `approval_lab/official_assets/`.

These fixtures verify software serialization. Passing them is not a model-capability result or evidence that all client configurations have been reproduced.
